summary_en: This phase 1 study tests osimertinib combined with carotuximab in advanced non-small cell lung cancer that has an EGFR mutation. Osimertinib is taken by mouth once daily at 40 mg or 80 mg, and carotuximab is given into a vein weekly for 4 weeks, then every 2 weeks, at 10 mg/kg or 15 mg/kg, until disease progression, withdrawal, or intolerance. The main measure is the number of dose-limiting toxicities, used to find the maximum tolerated dose.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa osimertinib combinado con carotuximab en cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas avanzado con mutación de EGFR. El osimertinib se toma por vía oral una vez al día, en dosis de 40 mg u 80 mg, y el carotuximab se administra en una vena cada semana durante 4 semanas y luego cada 2 semanas, en dosis de 10 mg/kg o 15 mg/kg, hasta progresión, retiro del estudio o intolerancia. La medida principal es el número de toxicidades limitantes de dosis, que se usa para encontrar la dosis máxima tolerada.
who_for: Stage IV or recurrent/metastatic non-squamous NSCLC with an EGFR activating mutation
Disease progression on a prior EGFR TKI, including osimertinib, depending on study part
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 0 to 2
Archival tumor tissue from after progression, or willingness to have a fresh biopsy
not_for: Past or current interstitial lung disease or clinically active lung inflammation
Prior exposure to carotuximab or any CD105-targeted antibody
Uncontrolled high blood pressure or an acute cardiovascular event in the past 6 months
